notes_for_editor: Company number: the register says 3611 (James Lake). A search snippet from SAH Archipedia's Camp Gibbs page names the 3604th Company for that camp, but that page returned HTTP 403 and was not read or cited, so the conflict is unresolved. The michigan.gov CCC page also returned 403. No visit report or current condition information was found, so the standing status rests on the register's 'only remaining' wording. Access is omitted because no source describes it.
